hard_stop: Any reproducible worsening beyond calibrated assay variability, failure of either named endpoint at either dose, or benefit confined to a single or nonadjacent exposure.
rationale: Requires convergent mitochondrial rescue in exactly two frozen assays rather than selection among favorable measurements.
status: provisional screening rule; calibrate and prospectively freeze before confirmatory dosing; not a clinical threshold
